caption: The drawing depicts two colored renderings of a carved bust. The larger rendering shows a bust of a person with dark brown skin and long, dark hair, adorned with a green feathered headdress and a yellow pattern headband. The figure's features include a neutral expression, a brown nose, and a painted blue marking on the cheek. The bust is clothed in a red garment with a pleated or textured collar, and is mounted on a decorative base featuring blue, green, and beige scrollwork with leaf designs. To the left of the figure, a light tan vertical shape with holes is visible, possibly representing a support or part of the mount. The dimension "3'" (three feet) is written along the left side, indicating the height of the bust. The smaller rendering at the lower right of the image shows a front view of the same bust, with similar details in the headdress, facial features, red clothing, and decorative base. The drawing background is plain off-white, with no additional elements.
title: Figurehead
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
